calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.stores, ty.store_weeks, ly.store_weeks AS ly_sw, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' OR d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctrl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
    WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' OR d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND c.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, m.mine, c.ctrl, m.mine - c.ctrl AS gap
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctrl c ON c.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(m.mine,0) - coalesce(c.ctrl,0)) > 0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH dups AS (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups USING (receipt_id,line_no) ORDER BY receipt_id,line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 14

WITH dups AS (SELECT receipt_id,line_no, count(*) c, min(sale_date) d, count(DISTINCT sale_date) nd, count(DISTINCT store_key) ns, count(DISTINCT product_key) np, count(DISTINCT net_amount) na, sum(net_amount) tot FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT c, nd, ns, np, na, count(*) n, min(d) mind, max(d) maxd, sum(tot) tot FROM dups GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT c.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN c.net_sales END),0) ty,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN c.net_sales END),0) ly,
  ROUND(100*(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN c.net_sales END)/SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN c.net_sales END)-1),1) g,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN d.fiscal_week END) wk_ty,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN d.fiscal_week END) wk_ly
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=c.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND c.store_id<900
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY g

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region
